notes: UI CLEANUP: the arsenal top row no longer crowds - SALVAGE moved clear of the buttons, and every screen re-audited for overlaps.

SKIN COVERAGE COMPLETE: 64 skins across all 30 turrets - every turret now has at least 2, and the 7 skinned-less towers got rare/elite designs (Oblivion Lance, Skybreaker Rail, Stormcall Tempest, and more).

GAUNTLETS: a new shop screen where the campaign camera V.O.X. idles in the background. The Commander Package costs 5,000 scraps and grants one random Commander skin per purchase (one at a time, never duplicates).
COMMANDER PACKAGE SKINS: blue-cyber hulls with red highlights, a yellow screen, and a glowing badge - they grow more detailed with every upgrade level.

COMMANDER POWER: these skins buff damage by 30% at levels 1-3, 20% at level 4, and 15% at max, and unlock the E key ability: two mini vehicles drive from the core down the path, stop in range, and fight with their own health.
Commander skins sit on a blue-and-red base plate (no more gray clashing), their arsenal chips read COMMAND in red-and-blue letters, and the crate icon is a fully detailed cyber crate.
MINI VEHICLES now deploy from the core at the far end of the lane and drive the route in reverse toward the enemy entry, with an E READY badge over the turret and a deploy button in the turret panel.

COMMANDER SKINS REDESIGNED: the hull is fully blue with red detailing, a yellow holograph screen mounts on the side and grows with level, and the badge pulses on top - every commander turret keeps its own distinct silhouette.
COMMANDER BUFF hits every stat now: damage, range, and fire rate all scale 30% / 30% / 30% / 20% / 15% / 15% across the levels, and the uplink aura scales too.
MINIS ARE TRUE COPIES: a vortex siphon mini drains up to 5 enemies with its beams, an uplink mini broadcasts its buff to nearby turrets, and every mini wears its owner's exact model.
MINIS no longer stack on spawn - they deploy side by side with a short stagger.
